page.content:
Pangoro is a huge panda-like Pokémon. It has gray and white fur and a large, fat belly. Its eyes are black and has a branch in its mouth and a furred cape. It has the same angry mood as that of Ursaring and Beartic.

page.overview:
What is Pangoro?

This Pangoro is a /-type Pokémon that appeared in Dream a Little Dream from Me!.

In a dream, it appeared as a Pancham, and it came to help Pikachu, alongside Chespin. It evolved into Pangoro.

Dark Pulse; Dark; XY102: Dream a Little Dream From Me!
